## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Record commands, observed outcomes, regression coverage and limits.

## Attribution

| Contribution | Actual tool or human | Actor/run reference | Model, if exposed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Author | | | |
| Code review | | | |
| Verification | | | |

Use `none` for human-only contributions and `not exposed` for unavailable metadata. Name any pending independent review explicitly. Do not infer the tool from the Git author or credit a transport bot with a review it did not perform.
